name: synapse
description: Claude Code integration for Synapse memory: pushes session transcripts to your Synapse (ingest), wires up the recall/remember MCP tools, and optionally two-way-syncs your skills library and mirrors opted-in config files for the dream lane. Set up with `synapse login`, which keeps this machine's settings in ~/.synapse/config.json.

SYNAPSE_URL.title: Synapse URL
SYNAPSE_URL.description: Base URL of your Synapse server (no path), e.g. https://synapse.example.net or http://localhost:8765. `synapse login` fills this in; keep it the same as `synapse config url`.

SYNAPSE_INGEST_TOKEN.title: Synapse token
SYNAPSE_INGEST_TOKEN.description: Optional, and best left blank. `synapse login` enrolls this machine and keeps its OWN device token in ~/.synapse/config.json, where the hooks and this plugin's MCP headers helper read it. A value here is only the fallback the MCP connection sends when that helper can't run. On a server with no sign-in configured, mint a token there with `docker compose exec mcp-server synapse-admin bootstrap "<label>"` and store it with `synapse login --token`.

synapse.headersHelper: python3 scripts/mcp_headers.py || python scripts/mcp_headers.py || py -3 scripts/mcp_headers.py
